classes.before_protocol: Only in ledgers of an earlier protocol than the corpus samples (its network and local ledgers are protocol 20 to 30); addable by mining the public archive's early ledgers.
classes.config_upgrade: Only in a ledger that applies a Soroban configuration upgrade.
classes.consensus: Only in meta from a node that records consensus messages.
classes.contract: Only from a contract written to produce it.
classes.impractical: Possible in principle, only past a limit no real or local ledger reaches.
classes.local_core: Producible by a local stellar-core scenario: a failure or shape that depends on ledger state.
classes.never_in_ledger: Cannot be in a closed ledger: set only by a check that a transaction failing it never gets past, or only on a stellar-core bug.
classes.upgrade: Only in a ledger that applies a network upgrade; producible by a local scenario that arms it.
